research.title: Steady Global Economic Growth in 2027 Outlook But Risks Tilted to Downside
research.summary: The global economy is forecast to grow 2.8% in 2027, though energy and AI could test its resilience, Jan Hatzius, chief economist and head of Goldman Sachs Research says on the Exchanges podcast. Dominic Wilson, senior advisor in Global Markets Research, predicts equity gains continuing.

research.title: Adam Goldston and Ryan Goldston on Defining Luxury Performance Footwear
research.summary: When APL (Athletic Propulsion Labs) set out to create basketball shoes that helped athletes instantly jump higher, the technology worked so well that the NBA banned the shoes for providing the wearer with an undue competitive advantage. That sparked viral global demand for the shoes and propelled APL to success. Adam Goldston and Ryan Goldston, co-founders of APL, explain the “luxury performance” philosophy of their footwear, their strategies for growing their business, and how they drew design inspiration from ziplines and Japanese soufflé pancakes.
